comment.body: Obsessed with this sentiment on friendship

post.title: Nice People Make Bad Friends
post.subtitle: On $5 Venmo requests, 3 a.m. cockroach emergencies, social climbing, and why real friendship requires inconvenience.

postSelection.text: If I buy you a $5 coffee, I am not asking you to Venmo me. You’ll get the next one. Or you won’t. Maybe I’ll buy ten coffees and thirty years from now you’ll be helping me move the Hamptons house into an offshore holding company before my ex-husband realizes what’s happening. Who cares?
